threat_model.threat_source: PAI, 'alone or in conjunction with humans'; also 'smart AI'/AI systems that design smarter AI and perform AI research
threat_model.objective_or_harmful_outcome: No intention stated; harmful end state described: 'faster than exponential growth in AI capacities, perhaps even to an 'intelligence explosion''
threat_model.capability: Able to innovate AI research; able to make 'the creation of even more powerful systems possible'; 'smart AI is able to design smarter AI which is in turn able to design even smarter AI and so on'; ability to perform AI research
threat_model.constraints_or_enabling_conditions: 'alone or in conjunction with humans' (PAI may innovate AI research alone or jointly with humans); 'In the most extreme case' (the faster-than-exponential growth / 'intelligence explosion' is conditioned on this most extreme case)

evidence.threat_source: PAI may— alone or in conjunction with humans— be able to innovate AI research; This gives rise to a recursive process where smart AI is able to design smarter AI which is in turn able to design even smarter AI and so on
evidence.objective_or_harmful_outcome: In the most extreme case, the ability of AI to perform AI research might lead to faster than exponential growth in AI capacities, perhaps even to an 'intelligence explosion'
evidence.capability: be able to innovate AI research and thus make the creation of even more powerful systems possible; smart AI is able to design smarter AI which is in turn able to design even smarter AI and so on; the ability of AI to perform AI research
evidence.constraints_or_enabling_conditions: PAI may— alone or in conjunction with humans— be able to innovate AI research; In the most extreme case, the ability of AI to perform AI research might lead to faster than exponential growth in AI capacities
